targets.name: Red hand brush
targets.notes: One complete red brush hangs on the upper-left wall; the metal wall hook is separate.

targets.name: Straw hat
targets.notes: The full brim, crown, blue band and bow identify a single hanging straw hat.

targets.name: Wall clock
targets.notes: A single round clock; its wall mounting hardware is separate from the round case.

targets.name: Yellow glove
targets.notes: One yellow glove drapes over a shelf; all visible fingers and the folded cuff are included.

targets.name: Blue mug
targets.notes: One blue enamel mug on the distant sill, including its rim, base and handle.

targets.name: Seed packet
targets.notes: The packet is tucked into a pot. Its top, paper outline and sunflower picture remain visible; the pot masks the bottom.

targets.name: Hand trowel
targets.notes: The red handle, metal collar and most of the steel blade are visible above the basket rim; the basket is not a target.

targets.name: Green watering can
targets.notes: A familiar can sits below the bench. A post, leaves and foreground pot hide part of its left side; the full visible handle and rose are included.

targets.name: Ball of twine
targets.notes: The complete ball and its two short loose ends are visible in the low cubby.

targets.name: Garden shears
targets.notes: One pair of orange-handled garden shears lies openly on the low stool; include both handles, blades and spring.

targets.name: Yellow boot
targets.notes: The toe, sole, open cuff and front of one boot are visible; the crate leg hides its back edge.

targets.name: Scallop shell
targets.notes: One complete ridged scallop shell rests on the right shelf, with both small base flanges included.

review.notes: All 12 actual ordinary objects inspected in enlarged source ROIs, source-plus-outline overlays and final plain/outlined context-preview contact sheets. Corrected full glove fingers, clock bezel, trowel and can silhouettes. Names and visible defining features agree. Context previews retain natural overlaps; no alpha-masked target cutouts are used. The foreground plant/pot hide part of the can and the crate hides the boot back. Physical iPhone testing and player acceptance are pending.
